reason: S1 adds the LHA format parser and LZH decompressor to archive_read_support_format_all, so H0 registers them, but H0's files[] contains no LHA input and only mutates less than 1% of bytes in existing non-LHA archive images. Consequently, its inputs do not adequately exercise the newly added LHA headers, extended-header parsing, or compressed-data state machine. This new input-format attack surface did not exist in S0, so the gap is commit-induced.
evidence: H0 calls archive_read_support_format_all(a), archive_read_open_memory(a, image, size), archive_read_next_header, and archive_read_data_block, so its API protocol would exercise LHA if a recognized LHA image were supplied.
H0 files[] lists inputs such as test_fuzz_1.iso.Z, test_compat_bzip2_1.tbz, test_compat_zip_1.zip, and test_read_format_lha is absent.
H0 restores each fixed rawimage and changes only numbytes = rand() % (size / 100), making recognized LHA header levels, methods, extended headers, and LZH bodies inadequately controllable.
S1 introduces ARCHIVE_FORMAT_LHA and 2,340 lines in archive_read_support_format_lha.c, including header levels 0-3 and the lzh_decode state machine.
recommended_action: Add at least one valid LHA seed to files[]—preferably covering supported header levels and lh5/lh6/lh7 compressed data—or add a dedicated input-driven harness that invokes the existing archive_read_support_format_all/open_memory/next_header/data_block protocol on arbitrary bytes.
